text_manual:
The explanation of the rules of "Tower of the Sorcerer"

The story:
----------
It may seem that the story is usual. 
Brave man is trying to save princess caught in the tower. 
But this is not so usual and normal story. Well, this story is even not from this game. 
Why? 
Check this while playing.

"Tower of the Sorcerer" is something between the Role Playing Game and puzzle. 
Play this with no hurry, thinking and deciding what would be the best.

And there is not the random element in this game.   
You will get the same result anytime, if it does that is same.

Setting Up TSW:
---------------
  1. Right when you start, you should choose whether you want to use the mouse or keyboard.
     (Mouse Mode is default)
  2. Next, you should choose which size font you'd like to use.
  3. Finally, choose a directory to save your games in.
     (The default is instdir/savedat.)

  + Display mode is two, 640x400 and 800x500.
    You can change it by menu bar. (The default is 640x400.)

Setup Information:
------------------
The first time you run the program, the setup file (TSW12.INI) is made in the Windows Directory.
When you delete this software, please delete it's setup file too. 

Playing the game:
-----------------
*Using the mouse:

You must click the arrow buttons on the bottom right of the window to move around.
And you can save the data and with the menu on the upper side.
(road savedata etc.,)

When you want to use items, click on their icon.

*Using the Keyboard:

To move around, use the arrow keys.
Pressing the ALT key chooses a menu.

When you want to use items, press the Enter key.
You can choose items by using the arrow keys.
If you've changed your mind, press the Escape key.  

+Summary:
The only keys that do anything are the arrow keys,
Enter key, Alt key, and Escape key.

The screen and the rule and parameter explanation:
--------------------------------------------------
*The floor number.
The indicator on the upper-left corner of the screen is the floor number.
It goes from 1 to the 50th floor.

*Your vital power.
Under the floor number is a heart that expresses your vital power.
Your life decreases when you are attacked by an enemy, and the game is over when it reaches zero.
You can recover life by taking medicine or offering to an altar.
Your life no limits. (^_^)

*Your offensive power.
Under the heart symbol is the offensive power (Indicated by a sword).
It determines the damage that the enemy takes.
The player can raise it by taking red crystals or offering gold to an alter.

*Your defensive power.
Under the sword symbol is a shield that shows the defensive power.
This determines how well protected the player is.
The player can raise this by taking blue crystal or offering gold to an altar.

*Your gold.
The coin beneath shield shows how much money you have.
The player gets gold when the player beats an enemy.
The player may then offer this gold to an altar or use it to buy articles from merchants.

*Your special items.
The special items that the player has are shown on the lower right of the screen.
The player can use items by clicking on them.

*The player's weapons.
On the upper right part of the screen where it says "WEAPON" shows the weapon that the player has.
When the player has a sword, it is shown there.
Having a weapon sufficiently adds to your offensive power.

*The player's shield.
Beneath the weapon, where "SHIELD" is written, is the player's shield.
If the player loses his shield, no shield is shown.
Owning a shield increases your defensive power.

*The player's keys.
On the right side of the screen are shown the blue, yellow, and red keys that you find.
Each key you get is shown in this box.
Every door you open takes away a key of that color.

*The information window
The enemy's information is on the bottom right corner of the screen.

*Status Bar
The blue bar at the bottom of the screen explains what happens.

*The message window.
When talking to characters, monsters and such, the message window will open and the message will be expressed.

On Battle:
----------
The battles start when the player engages the enemy.
The player hits the enemy first, then the enemy hits the player.
They continue to take turns in the battle (Friendly, aren't they?)
The first one whos life value reaches zero, loses.
If the player beats the monster, he takes the monster's gold.
So, here is how to calculate the results of battle:
The monster's damage by one attack
    = (Player's Attack Power) - (Monster's Strength). 

The player's damage by one attack.
    = (Monster's Power) - (Player's Strength). 

Therefore, the player can easily calculate the enemy's damage, and the damage of the player too.
(Even though the Hero Orb does this for you.)
And the player can't attack any enemy who is stronger than the player's Attack Power.

About fairies: 
--------------
When the player finishes off the major boss of an area, a fairy comes out, and scores the player's ability by adding the life, the offensive power, the defensive power, and the number of keys.

How to conquer this game:
-------------------------
Although it looks like a cute window on your computer screen, this game has an element of mental challenge.
You can't simply kill all the creatures and take all the items.
Though there are items scattered throughout each level, you should first determine the best way to defeat or avoid the enemies to get items or ascend the tower.

First Area Walk-through:
------------------------
TIPS:
Don't fight anyone you don't need to fight.
Don't fight the armed Skeleton before you get a shield.
 1. To start with, make your way to the fifth floor, and take the sword on that level first of all. 
   (There is a secret tunnel there, just press the wall)
 2. Next, you should offer to the altar on the fouth floor, and raise your defensive power.
 3. Then, gather all the crystals from the 1st floor to the 5th.
    Use the altar again and raise the defensive power. 
 4. Next, the player should take the shield from the 9th floor. 
 5. Gather all crystals from the 1st floor to the 10th.
    Beat the enemies that won't hurt you and gather coins.
    Raise the offensive and defensive power by offering to an altar.
 6. Although you shouldn't yet, you can beat the gate-keeper on the 8th floor and take the red key.
    Go to the 10th floor and beat the skeleton Boss.
    You may leave one blue key and five yellow keys if you need to. 

At the start, you may play around with the game, just to get used to playing it.
As you become used to it, you can figure out how to pass levels and the game too.


The explanation of each area:
-----------------------------
Now, I will explain each area briefly.

*The army corps of skeletons.
>From the 1st floor to the 10th. 
The enemies here are comparatively weak.
But the Skeleton who has a sword and a shield is rather trouble some.
Learn to master the basic operation and tactics in this area. 

*The corps of immortal force.
>From the 11st floor to the 20th. 
The undead system, (Zombies, Vampires and the like) will appear.
They are really powerful, and you will need the cross if you're thinking about fighting them.
The Giant Octopus is ready for you on this route.
And when you beat him, the precious item will appear.
It is more difficult than the first block(1st-10th floor), so be careful. 

*The Great Magic Master.
>From the 21st floor to the 30th. 
The Great Magic Master in this area is a fast boss!
For the time being, you just have to put up with him.
There is practically nothing in this area.

*The Golden Knight corps.
>From the 31st floor to the 40th. 
This area is ruled by the Knight corps which is made up of Knights, Swordsmen, Soldiers and the like.
Though they all have high fighting power, the boss never means what he says.
That's why the other bosses don't like the Golden Knight.
This boss is weak, but in this area, the Giant Dragon will block your way.

*The Magic Sergeant Zeno.
>From the 41st floor to the 50th.
This area is presided over by the Magic Sergeant Zeno, who is a sub officer of this tower.
Magical enemies will mainly appear.
The Magic Sergeant Zeno is the head bad-guy in this tower, and he is the ringleader who
captured the player in the intro.
He is the last boss, and if you should fight him seriously, you will have done nothing but killed yourself.

The explanation of the special items:
-------------------------------------
*The orb of the hero.

It will analyze the player's strength and the monster's strength, and forecast who will win.
But, when your strength is doubled by the cross and other items, keep in mind that this extra strength only works against certain creatures (like the Vampire and Zombie Knight).
You also need this item to use the save function.
So, please get this item from the old man on the 3rd floor.


*The orb of wisdom.

It will remember any information which you have heard.
When you look at the information later, you may find out something new.
You can get this item on the 6th floor.
But you must beat Skeleton B before getting it.

*The orb of flying.

If you use this next to stairs, you will be able to fly up or down any stairs which you have already been to (Like an elevator!).
It can never be exhausted, no matter how many times you use it
(So please use it a lot, because it saves time!)
This item is very convenient.
You can get it on the 1st floor.
But you must beat Skeleton B before getting it. 

*The Magic Mattock.

It can pull down the wall sides.
This is a very effective item.
When you beat big octopus that is on the 16th floor, this item will appear. 

*The Magic Elixir.

This is the magic medicine.
It will recover your vital power according to your offensive and defensive powers at that time.
Someone already has this item, but they might give it to you... 

*The destructible ball.

This is a bomb.
It can destroy any enemy character who is too strong.
But it has no effect against a part of the enemy character.

*The Warp Staff.

This is a very treasured item, the Space Staff.
You can warp to other places on the same floor.
You can't know where you will go.
Strange things may happen when you use it in certain areas. 

There are 15 special items. Collect them all!

It is up to you to rescue a princess who was locked in a magic tower.

Why?

help_topics.title: Fighting Explanation & About Fairies
help_topics.text:
Fighting Explanation & About Fairies

About Battle:

The battle starts when the player engages the enemy.
The first attack is the player hitting the enemy, and then the enemy hits the player.
The player and enemy take turns in battle. The first whose life reaches zero, loses.
If the player wins, the enemy's gold is taken.
So, here is how to calculate the battle

First Attack: monster's damage
= (The player's offensive power) - (The monster's defensive power).
Next Attack: Player's damage
= (The monster's offensive power) - (The player's defensive power).
Therefore, the player can calculate easily how many of attacks it will take, and how much damage the player will take. (The orb of hero can calculate this too.)
NOTE: The player can't attack any enemy who has Armor(defensive power) more powerful than the player's attack(offensive power).



About Fairies:
When the player clears an area, a fairy appears, and scores the player's ability from their vital power, offensive power, defensive power, the number of keys.

help_topics.title: How to win the game
help_topics.text:
How to win the game

How to win the game:

Although this game may appear to be a simple maze to the eyes, it is really an adventure.
You can't simply beat this game by killing the enemies and taking their stuff.
You may see items on screen, and enemies guarding them, but you must find out what to do, in what order, and at what cost. If the enemy is too strong for you, you should figure out whether to defeat the enemy and take the items, or to wait until you are stronger.

I will show you one way to conquer the first area.

1. Right after the introduction, take the sword which is on the 5th floor. (You may need to check for a secret tunnel...)
2. Next, find an altar and raise your defensive power.
3. And then, gather the power crystals from the first to five floors.
Offer to the altar again and raise your defensive power.
Don't fight anyone you don't need to.
4. Next take the shield from the 9th floor. Don't fight the armed Skeleton before this.
5. Gather all the crystals from the 1st to 10th floors. Kill enemies and gather coins. Then, raise the offensive and defensive power at the altar.
6. At worst, you may have to beat the gate-keepers on the 8th floor and take a red key.
Go to the 10th floor and beat the Skeleton boss. You may leave one purple key and five yellow keys, if you must.

In the beginning, it may be hard, because you don't have the knack of it yet. As you become used to the game, you should find out shortest course on your own.

help_topics.title: Area Explanation
help_topics.text:
Area Explanation

Area Explanation:

Now, I will briefly explain each area.

*The skeleton corps.
From the 1st floor to the 10th.
It's the first area. The enemies are comparatively weak. But the Skeleton with the sword and shield is rather troublesome. This area tests your tactical ability and game-play.

*The immortal force.
From the 11th floor to the 20th.
Undead creatures, such as Zombies and Vampires, will appear. As the Zombie and Vampire have very high powers, you will need the cross if you fight them.
A Giant Octopus will block your way. When you beat him, the precious items will appear. As this area is more difficult than from the first, be careful.

*The Great Magic Master.
From the 21st floor to 30th.
The Great Magic Master, who is the boss in this area, is very strong. For the time being, you must put up with him. There is practically nothing else in this area.

*The Golden Knight corps.
From the 31st floor to the 40th floor.
This area is presided over by the Knight corps, which is composed of Knights, Swordsmen, Soldiers, etcetera... Though this area is pretty hard, the boss is very enigmatic. For that reason, this Golden Knight seems to be disliked by other bosses. This boss may be weak, but beware the Giant Dragon who resides in this area.

*The Magic Sergeant Zeno.
From the 41st floor to the 50th floor.
This area is owned by the Magic Sergeant Zeno, who is a sub-officer of this tower. Magician- type enemies will mainly appear. The Magic Sergeant Zeno is a powerful influence in this tower, and he is the ringleader who imprisoned the player in the introduction. Zeno is the last boss. If you try and fight him, you will have done nothing but agreed to your own destruction.

help_topics.title: Special Item Explanation
help_topics.text:
Special Item Explanation

Special Item Explanation:

*The Hero Orb.

It will analyze the player's abilities VS the monster's abilities, and forecast the results of battle. But, keep in mind that when you have an item like the cross, the numbers are slightly different with creatures affected by it, like the Vampire and Zombie Knight.

*The Orb of Flight.

If you use this next to stairs, you will be able to fly up or down any stairs which you have been on. It never be exhausted even if you use many times. So, it will save a lot of time and trouble.

*The Orb of Wisdom.

It will remember any important information you have heard. If you use the orb often, something that was confusing may make more sense in your current situation.

*The mattock.

This is a magic mattock. It can create holes in the walls. As this can be a very effective item, please try using it in many ways. If you do, you should find out many strange and important ways to use it. I know I have left the mattock in a very precarious place, please don't give up in your search.

*The elixir.

This is the magic recovery medicine. It has the ability of healing according to your current offensive and defensive power, and depending on when you use it, it can be very effective.

*The destructible ball.

This is a bomb. It can kill enemies on all sides, but you should use it against enemies who you can't attack in normal ways.

*The Warp Staff.

You can warp to a random place on the same floor. Like the Mattock, you can find out many strange and important ways to use it.

There are 15 different special items. Collect them all!
